_drafted_note: Drafted 2026-08-23 from the world's OWN setup guide, and from the world's source where the repository publishes it. No field is filled in from memory or from what other games on the same console do.
_platform_source: setup guide https://github.com/aidanii24/ae3-archipelago/blob/main/docs/setup.md -- "PCSX2 Emulator (1.7 or higher)" and the NTSC-U disc SCUS-97501
_ap_world_name_note: NOT ESTABLISHED, deliberately left null. The world never writes the name literally: __init__.py has `class AE3World(World)` with `game = Meta.game`, and AE3_Client.py has `game: str = Meta.game` imported from `.data.Strings`. data/Strings.py and data/__init__.py were both read on 2026-08-23 and neither defines `game`. Writing "Ape Escape 3" here would be a guess, and a wrong ap_world_name makes Join fail rather than fail loudly.
description: The monkeys of Ape Escape 3 as a multiworld.
_description_source: written by us from the structure of the game - no text copied from the game itself
_checks_verified_note: Stays false until the RAM map has been MEASURED in-game. Nobody has played this. London warns at launch until it is true.
_requires_source: PS2 title - the game lives on a cartridge or disc the player owns, and the setup guide tells the player to supply it: An Ape Escape 3 NTSC-U disc (SCUS-97501)

rom._description_source: setup guide, word for word: "Ape Escape 3 [Please acquire and dump your own copy.] - NTSC-U `SCUS-97501`"
rom._hash_note: The guide states no checksum; none is claimed here.

client.name: Ape Escape 3 Archipelago
client._source: setup guide: "click the `Ape Escape 3 Archipelgo` button in Archipelago" (the guide's own spelling), with PINE central to the connection. As with Ape Escape 2: we have a PINE bridge, but nothing of ours reads this game's memory, so the protocol that would carry its checks is not established.

apworld._source: setup guide: "please see our [Releases](that address) to download the APWorld file."

patch._source: The guide describes no patch file or patching step. An absence is not a statement, so the model stays unknown.

_patch_extension_source: World source not read. catalog/SCHEMA.md locates this answer in the world's rom.py; the repository was not cloned and no apworld was downloaded (repo policy: addresses only). Flagged in every build until somebody reads it.
